newsitem.title: USA: China adds US soybeans, soyoil buys wk Nov 21 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: China adds US soybeans, soyoil buys wk Nov 21 - USDA.

text.p: China added 144,100 tonnes of U.S. soybeans to its purchases in the week ending Nov 21, U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday.
The purchases were detailed in USDA's weekly export sales report. They involved 6,900 tonnes of new sales, 140,000 tonnes in destination changes and cancellations of 2,800 tonnes.
Also, China bought 35,000 tonnes of soyoil, including 11,000 tonnes in new sales and 24,000 tonnes originally listed as unknown destinations.
China cancelled 4,500 tonnes of soymeal purchases.
